bays.restriction: Controlled parking zone — parking only in marked bays during the controlled hours: pay-and-display / RingGo bays for visitors and permit bays for permit holders. The point shown is the zone label point from the council's own parking zone map; the zone covers the surrounding streets — check the zone entry signs and bay signs.
bays.max_stay: 8 hours (the council's default maximum stay for pay-and-display parking where not otherwise indicated)
bays.tariff: Emissions-based pay-and-display charges (per hour, by CO2 band): Band 1 (0 g/km) £2.80; Band 2 (1-75 g/km) £2.80; Band 3 (76-120 g/km) £4.00; Band 4 (120-150 g/km) £4.50; Band 5 (151-186 g/km) £5.50; Band 6 (186-225 g/km) £6.00; Band 7 (225+ g/km) £7.00. Diesel surcharge +£1.00 per hour in any band. With a resident's visitor parking permit, charges are lower and start at £1.80 per hour. The council's map page states on-street pay and display charges do not apply on public holidays, and parking in each zone is free of charge outside the controlled times.
bays.pay: RingGo (app, web or phone — the council's e-parking service), on-street ticket machines (credit/debit card including contactless; cash in town centres), or a resident's visitor parking permit
bays.permits: Resident permit holders; visitor permits from £1.80 per hour
